Braid care

Keep your braids fresh for longer

Taking care of your braids is super important. A few simple habits keep your style neat and your scalp healthy.

Wrap at night

Sleep with a satin scarf or bonnet to reduce frizz.

Wash gently

Focus on the scalp with diluted shampoo, then rinse and dry well.

Moisturise your scalp

A light oil or braid spray keeps your scalp comfortable.

Know when to take out

Ask us how long your style should last and book your next look in time.
